DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お部屋の利用についてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss using a room, is that right?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 近所の四人で読書会を開きたいです。金曜の夕方に、机と椅子のある小さい部屋は空いていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 四人読書会用に金曜夕方の小机椅子付き部屋を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: Four of us from the neighborhood would like to hold a reading group. Is a small room with a table and chairs available on Friday evening?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about a small room with a table and chairs on Friday evening for a reading group of four. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 金曜の夕方は埋まっています。土曜の午後でしたら、小さい部屋に空きがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Friday evening is fully booked. A small room is available on Saturday afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 土曜も候補にできます。四人で座って本を読むので、長い机が一つある部屋を希望します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 土曜候補と長机一つを希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: Saturday could also work. Since four of us will sit and read books, we would like a room with one long table.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say Saturday is an option and request one long table. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: こちらの部屋には、机一つと椅子四脚をご案内できます。午後二時からの枠です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: We can offer this room with one table and four chairs. The time slot starts at two in the afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二時からですね。ほかの三人に、その時間で来られるか確認してから申し込みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 土曜二時枠を確認し三人の予定を聞くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: From two, then. I would like to check whether the other three can come at that time before applying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm the Saturday two o'clock slot and say you will check the other three people's schedules. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 申込用紙をお持ち帰りいただけます。活動の名前もお書きください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may take an application form home. Please write the name of your activity as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 「本を読む会」と書きます。代表の連絡先は私の番号にし、四人で利用することも記入します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 活動名本人番号と四人数を用紙へ記す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write “Book Reading Group.” I will use my phone number as the representative's contact number and also state that four people will use the room.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will enter the activity name, your own number and the number of participants, four, on the form. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 参加される皆さんの予定が合いましたら、空き状況を再度ご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: Once everyone's schedules match, please check availability again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。今日は用紙を持ち帰り、土曜二時の候補を伝えます。予定が合ったら、空きを聞いて申込用紙を出します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 予定確認後空きを再確認して申込むと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will take the form home today and tell them about Saturday at two as a possibility. If our schedules match, I will ask about availability and submit the application form.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will check availability again and apply after confirming everyone's schedules. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの用紙をどうぞ。読書会のご準備にお役立てください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is the form, then. I hope it helps you prepare for your reading group. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 診察の後に、確認したいことがございますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything you would like to check after your consultation?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 次の検査の持ち物を聞き忘れました。この案内の空いた所へ質問を一つ書いたので、担当の方へ渡してもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 次回検査持物について質問紙を担当へ渡す依頼をする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I forgot to ask what to bring to my next test. I wrote one question in a blank space on this information sheet. Could you give it to the person in charge?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for the written question about what to bring to the next test to be passed to the person in charge. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの案内ですね。どの欄についてのご質問でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: This information sheet, correct? Which section is your question about?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 持参する物の欄です。前にもらった検査の紙も必要か、聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 前回検査紙の要否を持参物欄で尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: The section about items to bring. I want to ask whether I also need the test paper I received before.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask in relation to the items-to-bring section whether the previous test paper is needed. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: その質問を担当へ伝えます。前の紙は、今お持ちですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will pass that question to the person in charge. Do you have the previous paper with you now?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家にあります。日付は自分の予定表に残っているので、それも質問の横へ書き足します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 紙は自宅で前回日付を質問へ追加すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: It is at home. I have the date in my planner, so I will add that beside the question too.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say the paper is at home and you will add the previous date to the question. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お名前と、次の予約日も一緒に確認できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Could we also confirm your name and your next appointment date?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前はこの上にあります。次は案内に書かれた来月の十日です。担当の方に、この案内と質問を見ていただきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 本人氏名と来月十日の予約を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: My name is up here. My next appointment is on the tenth of next month, as written on the information sheet. I would like the person in charge to look at this sheet and my question.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Point out your name and your appointment on the tenth of next month. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お預かりして確認します。ここでお待ちいただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will take this and check. Could you wait here?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。受付へ同じ質問をもう一度出しに行かず、こちらで待ちます。案内の紙は確認が終わったら返してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 看護師所で待ち確認後案内紙返却を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I will wait here instead of going to reception to submit the same question again. Please return the information sheet when you have finished checking.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will wait at the nurse's station and would like the information sheet returned after the check. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へ質問を届けます。確認が終わるまでこちらでお待ちください。どうぞお大事になさってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will deliver your question to the person in charge, then. Please wait here until we have finished checking. Take care.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 建物の写真についてのお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about photographing the building?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 地域の散歩地図を作っています。この交番を目印にするため、建物の外から写真を一枚撮ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 散歩地図目印用に交番外観一枚の撮影許可を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am making a local walking map. May I take one photo of this police box from outside to use it as a landmark?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask permission to take one exterior photo of the police box as a landmark for a walking map. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この建物の外観でしたら、こちらの歩道の端から撮っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: If it is the exterior of this building, you may photograph it from this edge of the sidewalk.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: その位置へ移ります。地図を見る人が分かるよう、入口の建物名の表示も写真へ入れたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 指示位置へ移り建物名表示を含めたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will move to that spot. I would also like to include the building-name sign in the photo so people using the map will recognize it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the indicated spot and would like to include the building-name sign. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ここからなら、外観と表示を一緒に見られます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: From here you can see both the exterior and the sign together.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。今、人が前を通っているので、通り終わってから撮ります。職員の方を写すためではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通行人通過後に職員でなく建物を撮ると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. People are passing in front now, so I will take the photo after they have passed. I am not taking it to photograph staff members.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Explain that you will photograph the building, rather than staff, after passersby have gone by. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 地図に付ける説明は、お決まりですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Have you decided what description to put on the map?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 建物名と、この角の目印になることだけを書きます。仕事の紹介記事やインタビューではなく、道の案内に使います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 建物名角目印のみの道案内で記事取材でないと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write only the building name and that it is a landmark at this corner. It is for directions, rather than an article about the work here or an interview.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say it is for directions with only the building name and corner landmark, rather than reporting an article or interview. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 撮り終わりましたら、通路を空けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please keep the passage clear when you have finished taking the photo.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一枚撮れました。建物名も読めます。道の脇で画面をしまい、家で散歩地図へ合わせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示読める一枚を確認し収納後自宅で地図へ合わせる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have taken one photo. The building name is readable too. I will put my device away at the side of the road and fit the photo into the walking map at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm you have one photo with a readable sign, put the device away, and say you will fit it into the map at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、地図作りにお役立てください。お足元にもお気をつけて。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope it helps with your map, then. Please watch your step too. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 地域の使用済み切手の活動についてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the community's used-stamp collection activity?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 案内を見て、家で集めた切手を持ってきました。封筒から切った物が、この小袋に入っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家庭の使用済み切手を地域活動案内により持参したと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: I saw the notice and brought stamps I collected at home. The pieces cut from envelopes are in this small bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you brought used stamps from home after seeing the notice about the community activity. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: この活動の受取箱は、窓口の横にあります。使用済みの物をお持ちですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: The collection box for this activity is beside the counter. You have brought used stamps, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。郵便が届いたあとに集めました。新しく買った切手は、別の封筒に入れて家へ残しています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使用済みのみで新品切手は自宅と説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I collected them after the mail arrived. I left the newly purchased stamps at home in a separate envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that these are only used stamps and the new stamps are at home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 袋に、活動の名前を書いてお出しいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: You may write the activity's name on the bag and hand it in.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 案内にある「切手を集める会」と書きます。切手が袋の中でこぼれないよう、口を閉じます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 架空活動名を袋へ書き口を閉じると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will write “Stamp Collection Group,” as shown on the notice. I will close the bag so the stamps do not spill out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will write the fictional activity name on the bag and close it. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 周りの封筒の紙は、付いたままでもお受けする案内です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: The instructions say we can accept the stamps with the surrounding envelope paper still attached.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紙ごと入っています。今日は切手だけをさらに剥がさず、この小袋のままでお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 封筒紙付きのまま小袋で渡すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: They are in there with the paper. Today I will hand them over in this small bag without peeling the stamps off any further.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will hand them over in the small bag with the envelope paper still attached. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お持ちの案内は、ご自身で残されますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Would you like to keep the notice you have?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。次も集めたいので、案内は持ち帰ります。この袋を受取箱へ入れ、手元の紙は鞄へ戻します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を保管し袋のみ受取箱へ出すと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I want to collect more next time, so I will take the notice home. I will put this bag in the collection box and return the paper I am holding to my bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will keep the notice and put only the small bag in the collection box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご協力ありがとうございます。それでは、活動の案内を大切にお持ちください。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for your cooperation. Please keep the activity notice safe, then. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 残高証明のご相談ですね。ご希望を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to discuss a balance certificate. Please tell me what you need.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 提出先から英語と言われました。金額は円の表示で、今日の残高の証明を二通お願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 英語円表示今日残高の証明二通を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: The recipient has asked for English. I would like two copies certifying today's balance, with the amount shown in yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Request two copies certifying today's balance in English with amounts in yen. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 英語、円表示、本日付で二通ですね。この窓口では、その希望の申込みをご案内できます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Two copies in English, in yen, dated today, correct? We can guide you through applying for that here at this counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: お願いします。提出先の指定を紙に書きました。名前の英字も、この紙の表記で確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 提出先指定紙と本人英字氏名照合を依頼する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Please do. I wrote the recipient's requirements on this paper. I would also like to check my name's English-letter spelling against the spelling on this paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to check the written recipient requirements and your name's spelling in English letters. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: ご本人の資料と合わせて確認します。受け取りは明日の午後をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: We will check it together with your identification documents. We can arrange collection for tomorrow afternoon.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 明日の午後なら来られます。会社へ出す予定は明後日なので、受け取ってから封筒へ入れます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 翌午後受取が可能で翌々日提出予定と伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: I can come tomorrow afternoon. I plan to submit it to my company the day after tomorrow, so I will put it in an envelope after collecting it.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you can collect it tomorrow afternoon and plan to submit it the following day. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: こちらの案内の手数料は、一通三百円、二通で六百円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: The fee in this information sheet is three hundred yen per copy, so six hundred yen for two copies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 二通で六百円ですね。同じ日付と同じ表記で二通必要です。一通は提出し、もう一通は自分で残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 二通六百円と同一日付表記提出保管用途を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: Six hundred yen for two copies, then. I need two with the same date and spelling. I will submit one and keep the other myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Confirm two copies cost six hundred yen, with identical dates and spelling, one for submission and one to keep. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: この申込用紙に、ご希望の言語と通数をご記入ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please enter your preferred language and number of copies on this application form.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 英語と二通を書きました。本日付、円表示、名前の英字も質問の紙と照らして、本人確認の資料をお見せします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 英語二通申込記入後日付通貨氏名と本人資料を提示する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have written English and two copies. I will also check today's date, yen amounts and my name's spelling in English letters against the question sheet and show my identification documents.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: After entering English and two copies, show the date, currency, name and identification documents. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの用紙をお預かりします。確認と受付をご案内します。ご準備ありがとうございました。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will take this form, then. I will guide you through verification and acceptance of the application. Thank you for preparing everything. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 麦茶をお探しでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for barley tea?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。煮出して作る袋を買いたいです。家の容器は一リットルなので、一袋でどれくらい作るか見たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 一リットル容器用に煮出し麦茶一袋の量を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I would like to buy bags for making it by boiling. My container at home holds one liter, so I would like to see how much one bag makes.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask how much one bag of barley tea for boiling makes, for a one-liter container. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの箱には、一袋で一リットル分と書かれています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: This box says one bag makes one liter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 容器と同じ量ですね。毎日一回作る予定ですが、この箱には何袋入っていますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一袋一リットルを確認し毎日用の箱内袋数を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: That is the same amount as my container. I plan to make it once every day. How many bags are in this box?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm one bag makes one liter and ask how many bags the box contains for daily use. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 二十袋入りです。側面にも、袋数が表示されています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: There are twenty bags. The number of bags is also shown on the side.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二十袋なら、二週間の予定に足りますね。今回はこの箱を一つ買います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 二十袋が二週間予定に足りると一箱を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Twenty bags will be enough for my two-week plan. I will buy one of these boxes this time.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Choose one box, saying twenty bags are enough for the planned two weeks. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 作り方の表示も、ご覧になりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-07.translation: Would you like to look at the preparation instructions too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。家で読むため、表示が箱の裏にあることを確かめます。袋を取り出しても、箱は残しておきたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 自宅用説明表示場所と箱保管を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will check that the instructions are on the back of the box so I can read them at home. I want to keep the box even after taking the bags out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Check where the instructions are for reading at home and say you will keep the box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 表示は裏面の、この部分です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: The instructions are in this section on the back.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 場所が分かりました。今日は一箱だけを選び、家で箱の説明を読んでから作ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 表示箇所を理解し一箱購入後家で読むと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: I see where they are. I will choose just one box today and make the tea after reading the instructions on the box at home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you understand where the instructions are and will read them at home after buying one box. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの一箱をどうぞ。ご来店ありがとうございました。お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Here is your one box, then. Thank you for shopping with us. Have a safe trip home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 読み聞かせへご参加でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you here for the story reading?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもと来ました。自分の小さい折り畳み椅子を持ってきたので、後ろの端へ置ける場所はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもと参加し持参折畳椅子の後方端置場を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I came with my child. I brought my own small folding chair. Is there a place at the back edge where I can set it down?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you are attending with your child and ask about a place at the back edge for your folding chair. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの空いている場所でしたら、椅子を置いて聞いていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: You may set up your chair and listen in this available space.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: そこへ置きます。子どもも隣へ座りたいので、二人が並べる幅があるか見ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 二人並ぶ幅を確認し置くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: I will put it there. My child wants to sit beside me, so I will check whether there is enough width for the two of us side by side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you will check there is enough width for two people side by side and set up there. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お子さんには、前の方も見えそうですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Does it look as though your child can see the front too?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 私の椅子の横なら見えます。鞄を子どもの前に置かず、自分の足元へ寄せます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 子ども視界を確かめ鞄を本人足元へ寄せる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: My child can see from beside my chair. I will keep my bag by my own feet instead of putting it in front of my child.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Check your child's view and move your bag to your own feet. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: お話が始まるまで、少しお時間があります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: There is a little time before the story starts.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今のうちに椅子を広げます。途中で場所を探し直さなくてよいよう、子どもにもここに座ると伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 開始前に椅子を準備し子どもへ席を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I will unfold the chair now. I will also tell my child we will sit here so we do not have to find a different spot in the middle.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Prepare the chair before the start and tell your child where you will sit. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 終わったあと、椅子はご自身でお持ち帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please take your chair home yourself when it is over.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。最後まで聞いてから、子どもと鞄を持ち、椅子を畳んで帰ります。この場所で参加をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 終了まで聞き私物と椅子を持って帰ると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. After listening to the end, I will take my child and bag, fold the chair and go home. We would like to take part from this spot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will listen to the end and take your belongings and chair home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらでお待ちください。親子でお話をお楽しみください。ご参加ありがとうございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22214-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait here, then. Enjoy the story together with your child. Thank you for joining us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 乗車の列をお探しですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking for the boarding line?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。人と人の間に隙間があるので、そこへ並んでよいのか分かりません。最後尾はどこですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 列途中の隙間に入れるか最後尾位置を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. There is a gap between people, so I do not know whether I may line up there. Where is the end of the line?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask whether you can enter a gap in the middle of the line and where the end is. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 青い鞄をお持ちの方が最後です。その後ろへお並びください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: The person with the blue bag is last. Please line up behind them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。隙間は途中だったのですね。あの方の後ろへ移ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 青鞄の人が最後と理解して後ろへ移る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. That gap was in the middle of the line, then. I will move behind that person.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you understand the person with the blue bag is last and will move behind them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お荷物も、ご自身のそばへお寄せください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please also keep your luggage close to you.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: キャリーかばんを足元へ置きます。後ろの方が来る所を空けたいので、横へ大きく広げないようにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: キャリーを足元へ寄せ後続位置を空ける。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I will put my wheeled bag at my feet. I want to leave room for people coming behind me, so I will keep it from spreading far out to the side.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Move your wheeled bag to your feet and leave room for those joining behind you. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご自身がお並びの位置から、列が進みましたらお進みください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please advance from your place in the line when the line moves.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。さっき見た隙間へ鞄だけ置いて、自分の順番を作るつもりにはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 隙間へ鞄だけ置いて順番を確保しないと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I will not put just my bag in the gap I saw earlier to try to secure a place in line.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you will not secure a place by putting only your bag in the gap. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: どなたかとご一緒でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 一人です。この位置で待ちます。列が進んだら鞄も一緒に動かし、離して置きません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 単独乗車で進む列と鞄を一緒に動かすと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: I am on my own. I will wait in this spot. When the line moves, I will move my bag with me and will not leave it apart from me.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you are boarding alone and will move your bag along with the line. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、列に沿ってお待ちください。お気をつけてご乗車ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please wait along the line, then. Take care as you board.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: アンケートのご提出でしょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: まだ提出しません。家族がネットで答えたと今聞きました。知らずに紙へも書いたので、二つ出すことになるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 家族ネット回答を知り未提出紙との重複を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: I am not submitting it yet. I just heard that my family answered online. I filled out the paper without knowing, so I would like to ask whether that would mean submitting it twice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Discuss the duplicate paper response you have not submitted after learning your family answered online. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: このアンケートの案内では、ご家庭から一回ご回答いただく形です。紙はまだお預かりしていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: The instructions for this questionnaire call for one response per household. We have not taken your paper form yet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一家庭で一回ですね。家族の回答は、同じ案内のコードから送ったそうです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 一家庭一回答の案内を理解し同コードで送信したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: One response per household, then. My family says they sent their response using the code on the same notice.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you understand there is one response per household and explain that it was sent using the same code. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 送信が済んでいることを、ご家族へもう一度お確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please check once more with your family that submission is complete.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 今確認できました。完了の表示が出たと言っています。紙は家へ持ち帰ります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 家族へ完了表示を確認して紙持帰りと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have just confirmed it. They say the completion message appeared. I will take the paper form home.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you confirmed the completion message with your family and will take the paper home. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 紙に書いた内容について、追加で担当へ伝えたいことはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is there anything from your written response you would also like to convey to the person in charge?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 私が書いた意見も家族と少し違います。二件目として出すのでなく、別の意見を伝える窓口があるか知りたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 異なる自己意見を二件目回答でなく別窓口へ伝えたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: My written opinion is a little different from my family's too. I would like to know whether there is another contact for sharing that opinion, rather than submitting a second response.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask to convey your different opinion through another contact rather than as a second questionnaire response. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: アンケート以外のご意見は、こちらの相談先へお尋ねいただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: For opinions outside the questionnaire, you may ask this consultation contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: その案内をください。今日は紙を提出せず、家族と話してから、自分の意見をどの方法で伝えるか決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 案内を受取り家族相談後に意見伝達法を決めると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please give me that information. I will not submit the paper today. After talking with my family, I will decide how to convey my own opinion.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Accept the information and say you will decide how to share your opinion after discussing it with your family. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの案内をお持ちください。ご確認いただき、ありがとうございました。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please take this information, then. Thank you for checking. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご面会のお申し込みでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Would you like to register for a visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。家族の知り合いを訪ねました。この紙に病室の番号はありますが、名字しか分からないので、先に本人へ確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 面会相手の病室番号と姓のみで本人氏名確認を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I have come to visit an acquaintance of my family. I have the hospital room number on this paper, but I only know their surname, so I would like to confirm their name with them first.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say you have only the room number and surname of the person you are visiting and would like to confirm their full name with them. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 病室の番号だけではなく、お名前も確認します。ご本人へ連絡できますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: We check the name as well as the hospital room number. Can you contact the person?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 携帯へ電話できます。今ここでお名前を確かめてから、受付をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 相手へ携帯で連絡可能で確認後受付を希望すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: I can call their mobile phone. I would like to confirm their name here now and then ask you to register my visit.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say you can call their mobile and would like to register after confirming their name. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: お電話は、こちらの通話できる場所でお願いします。終わりましたらお戻りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please make your call in this area where calls are allowed. Come back when you have finished.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。短く聞いて戻ります。家族から聞いた呼び名ではなく、お名前を全部聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 通話場所へ移り呼称でなくフル氏名を聞くと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will ask briefly and return. I will ask for their full name rather than the name my family calls them by.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will move to the calling area and ask for the full name rather than a familiar form of address. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: ご面会先のお名前は、全部確認できましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: Were you able to confirm the full name of the person you are visiting?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい。お名前をこの紙へ書きました。大きな声で呼ぶのでなく、こちらを見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 確認氏名を紙へ記し大声でなく職員へ示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes. I wrote the name on this paper. Could you look at it here instead of my calling it out loudly?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Write the confirmed name on paper and show the staff member instead of saying it loudly. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拝見します。ご面会の希望と合わせて、担当へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: Let me see. I will check with the person in charge along with your request for a visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: お願いします。本人も私が来たと知っていますが、面会の案内はまだ聞いていないので、ここで待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 本人来訪認知と未確認面会案内を分け受付待機すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Please do. The person knows I have arrived, but I have not yet heard the visiting instructions, so I will wait here.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Distinguish the person's awareness of your arrival from the visiting instructions you have not yet checked, and say you will wait at reception. Say this in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、担当へ確認します。紙をお持ちになってお待ちください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-22215-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will check with the person in charge, then. Please keep the paper with you and wait. Goodbye.
